integrity: A complete standard-library verifier is enclosed for face enumeration, matching, acyclicity, and a mod-two homology cross-check. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the Morse complex of the six-vertex triangular prism, equivalently the second iterate on a triangle boundary, is classified. The method is an exhaustive finite discrete-Morse matching. Other iterates and graphs are outside scope; relevant inaccessible thesis is a residual literature risk.
title: The second Morse complex of a triangle boundary is a wedge of \(64\) four-spheres
